english.title: Produce false document or information to secure evasion of NHS charge
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) produced

(A)_[a document,]_
(B)_[information,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENT OR INFORMATION..), which you knew to be false in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY FALSE PARTICULAR..), with a view to securing for

(C)_[yourself]_
(D)_[another, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..),]_

the evasion of

(E)_[a charge under the National Health Service Act 2006 in respect of the provision of goods]_
(F)_[part of a charge under the National Health Service Act 2006 in respect of the provision of goods]_
(G)_[a charge under the National Health Service Act 2006 in respect of the provision of services]_
(H)_[part of a charge under the National Health Service Act 2006 in respect of the provision of services]_

to which section 192 of the Act applied, namely **(..SPECIFY GOODS OR SERVICES..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 194(1)(a), (2)(b) and (3) of the National Health Service Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
